title: What a rainy night in Vice City could feel like
hook: This is NOT GTA VI footage. But imagine this.
voiceover: Quick heads up: everything you are seeing is an AI-generated fan concept, not real gameplay and not from Rockstar. Picture a storm rolling over a neon coastline at midnight. Rain on the asphalt, a getaway car idling under a flickering motel sign, sirens somewhere far off. That is the mood fans keep imagining for Vice City. We built this concept to ask you one question. What should the first night in the game feel like?
cta: Comment one word that describes your perfect first night.
caption: AI-generated fan concept, not real GTA VI gameplay. What should the first night feel like?
